howToPlay: Focus on hitting enemies to upgrade your attack and Super stages as quickly as possible. Use Snappy Shooting to boost token collection and Tactical Retreat to survive while re-engaging. Prioritize staying alive to maintain your upgraded firepower throughout the match.
gears: Choose DAMAGE to maximize output at high stages and SHIELD to compensate for the lower base health. GADGET COOLDOWN is also useful to cycle through tokens faster.
trait: Clancy suits players who enjoy a brawler that scales in power and becomes increasingly dominant as the match progresses.
